items.headline: September surprises: Our unexpected all-portal team
items.description: Unlikely stars a month ago, here are the biggest portal surprises at every position.

items.headline: JaMarcus Shephard pays tribute to Mike Leach with gameday outfit
items.description: Shephard, who worked for Leach in 2016 with Washington State, wore an ensemble similar to one of Leach's looks during Oregon State's win over Montana.

items.headline: Oregon State visits UTEP in Week 4
items.description: Oregon State (1-2) at UTEP (1-2), Sept. 26 at 9 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Atkinson throws for 5 TDs, runs for another score as Oregon State beats Montana 52-17
items.description: — Braden Atkinson threw five touchdown passes and ran for another score, tying the Oregon State record for total touchdowns in a game, Oregon State beat Montana 52-17 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Heisman of the week: Drew Mestemaker can run now, too?
items.description: We'll hand out some hardware every week -- and the winner for Week 2 is Oklahoma State's quarterback.

items.headline: Week 2's best moments: Arch's defining moment, Michigan's revival and Oregon's downfall
items.description: Bounce-back performances from Texas, Michigan and Oklahoma State lead the way in Week 2.
